senses.gloss: (cmp. לְפֵי) to cling to, to clasp. Tanḥ. B’har 3 (ref. to וילפת, Ruth III, 8) לְפָפַתּוֹ she clasped him; Ruth R. to l. c. לפפתו כחזזית (some ed. לפתתו), v. חֲזָזִית.

units: <cite ref="Bekhorot 41a:7">Bekh. 41ᵃ</cite> (interpret. <cite ref="J00399"><he>יַלֶּפֶת</he></cite>) <he>שמְלַפֶּפֶת והולכת וכ׳</he> it continues to cling (to the body) to the day of death, v. supra.

<cite ref="Sotah 3b:13">Sot. 3ᵇ</cite> (play on <he>ילפתו</he>, <cite ref="Job 6:18">Job VI, 18</cite>) <he>מְלַפַּפְתּוֹ והולכת לפניו וכ׳</he> (sin) clings to him and goes before him on the day of judgment.
<cite ref="Shabbat 129b:17">Sabb. 129ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>מְלַפְּפִין את הוולד וכ׳</he> you may swathe a new-born child on the Sabbath.—Part. pass. <he>מְלוּפָּף</he>; f. <he>מְלוּפֶּפֶת</he>.

<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 3">Deut. R. s. 3</cite> <he>התורה … חתומה באש ומל׳ באש</he> the Torah scroll which was given to Moses,—the skin was of white fire, written upon with black fire, sealed with fire and swathed with bands of fire.
